column2: Th-this is incredible!!
Lord $$モーゼ$$, you...!
Everyone, hurry on ahead!
Why? I want to watch a little longer.
This spell draws a vast amount of $$生き血$$ from the one who casts it...
Sir $$ヨハネ$$.
I am grateful for your concern, but at this point, please do not trouble yourself with me any longer.
More than that, you must all be wondering...
why I possess knowledge like this.
I was born to a black-$$羽$$ed $$神官$$,
yet I came into this $$この世$$ with white, bat-like $$羽$$...
You have the $$血$$ of black-$$羽$$ed people?
White, bat-like $$羽$$?
Yes. Ordinarily, I would have been killed for that, but my father used his power
to dye my $$羽$$ black and make me his heir.
Consequently, I was able to obtain a rather high position in the $$教団$$.
And this $$邪道騎士$$ armor, which I obtained there,
is a relic of the demon $$ルーイソス$$, preserving every $$記憶$$ of events in Heaven!
Then do you know about the $$教皇$$ too?
However, all I can tell you now is...
that the $$教皇$$ possesses both a black-$$羽$$ed and a white-$$羽$$ed heart...
and that she is a young woman.
The $$教皇$$... a young woman...?
The $$教皇$$...
